basis: The Fed raised rates 25 bp to 3.75%-4.00%; the unanimous vote and projections pointing to another likely 2026 hike remain the dominant macro signal.

Thin overnight liquidity increases wick and false-break risk; structural stops and no-chase boundaries remain mandatory.
